about.statement: 9 years turning complex requirements into products that ship — and keep running.
about.body: For 9 years I've worked across the full stack, with deep roots in PHP and Symfony (7+ years) and four years building front-ends in React, TypeScript and Next.js. I currently lead PHP/Symfony engineering at Novity, and have partnered with international teams — Unlocked (NL), Kleap (CH), Ubiweb (CA) — as engineer, tech lead and founding team member. Claude Code and Cursor are part of my daily workflow, and I care about clean architecture, typed contracts between front and back, and shipping things that last.
